summary: @or-sdk/library-categories preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated math_init.js payload
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (oven-sh/bun v1.3.13) and uses it to execFileSync a ~728KB heavily obfuscated file `math_init.js` shipped at the tarball root. The wrapper `setup.mjs` and the payload both use string-array / char-code / hex-named identifier obfuscation (`_0xNNNN`, `// @bun @bun-cjs`, ~500-entry numeric lookup table). The payload's name suggests a math helper but the file has no relation to the package's advertised `LibraryCategories` SDK, and its logic is not readable. Running the payload under an alternate downloaded runtime evades Node-oriented supply-chain scanners while still executing arbitrary code on the installer's host at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
